name: Moyours
hero_text: A place to find your game, grow in confidence and take your next step. Discover youth football at Moyours, in the heart of Abuja.
address: Suite A05, Tsukunda House, Central Business District, Abuja

programs.name: Foundations
programs.headline: Small steps. A lifelong love of the game.
programs.description: Playful sessions give young footballers space to explore, make friends and feel comfortable with the ball.

programs.name: Development
programs.headline: Find your feet. Develop your game.
programs.description: Build technique and match awareness through focused practice, small-sided games and the experience of being part of a team.

programs.name: Performance
programs.headline: Train with purpose. Play with ambition.
programs.description: A focused pathway for older players, bringing individual development, competitive football and preparation for the next level together.
